name: "Hidden Treasure" Muffins with Strawberry Jam, Blueberries & Chocolate Chips

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat 12 muffin cups with cooking spray. (Alternatively, line a muffin pan with paper liners.)
Wash and dry blueberries. Place blueberries, jam, and chocolate chips each in their own small bowl. Set muffin "treasures" aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (6 oz) pkg blueberries
¼ cup strawberry jam
¼ cup milk chocolate chips

instructions.primary_message: Place flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dry ingredients.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups all-purpose flour
½ cup granulated sugar
1 tbsp baking powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place milk, oil, egg, and vanilla in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine. Add wet ingredients to the bowl with the dry ingredients and gently stir until batter is just combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup whole milk
⅓ cup neutral vegetable oil
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Use half of the batter to partially fill the muffin cups (about 2 tablespoons per cup). Take turns adding about one tablespoon of the treasure (you can use one or several in each muffin!). Top with remaining batter, then sprinkle (or dollop) any remaining treasure over top of the muffins.

Place muffin pan in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, 5 minutes. Remove muffins from the pan and set on a wire rack to cool completely, 30 minutes.
Serve cooled muffins, discover your hidden treasure, and enjoy!
